summary: An intrusion-toolkit staging host on the OFAC-sanctioned bulletproof operator FUNNULL (routing via CTG Server, AS152194) remains live and flagged as of 2026-09-10 (VirusTotal 10, ThreatFox botnet C2, ports 80/7000). detail: An intrusion-toolkit staging host on the OFAC-sanctioned bulletproof operator FUNNULL Technology (which routes through CTG Server, AS152194). The host 192[.]252[.]187[.]26 remains Shodan-visible as of 2026-09-10 on ports 80/7000, VirusTotal-flagged (10) and classified by ThreatFox as botnet command-and-control. Contents: a ProcDump-based credential-dumping utility, a plink SSH tunneller, and a payload masquerading as a Microsoft Word executable. FUNNULL's sanctioned status and CTG upstream give the staging infrastructure takedown resistance.
